ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the impact on care workers and clients
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are care workers and clients affected by the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid system, highlighting the need for increased oversight and transparency. By following the money and analyzing data, we can identify patterns and connections that may lead to further investigation and accountability.
